caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a piece of driftwood or a carved wooden tool with a flat, elongated, and slightly curved shape. The object is oriented horizontally, with one end appearing wider and more rectangular, tapering off into a narrower, forked or split end. The wood grain and texture are depicted in shades of brown and gray, with some darker and lighter areas indicating natural wear, age, or knots in the wood. There is a visible notch or groove near the wider end. The background of the drawing is plain and unembellished, consisting of a light beige or off-white color, providing contrast to the detailed rendering of the wooden object in the center of the composition.
title: Bootjack
